## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `go vet ./...`, `go test -race ./...` and `golangci-lint run` pass
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`); it drives the version and changelog
- [ ] README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No credentials, card numbers or payer data in code, fixtures or logs
- [ ] If this depends on API behaviour: documentation link or a redacted real response included
